# CJ Young Sommelier - AI Context Map

## Project Summary
CJ Young Sommelier is an AI-driven liquor analytics platform for tracking LOT-specific chemical composition changes, predicting sensory scores using machine learning, and generating comprehensive flavor reports via Google Gemini LLM. The platform integrates chemical analysis (GCMS), ML-based quality prediction, and AI-powered sensory profiling to provide actionable insights for beverage quality control and product development. Built with Streamlit for interactive web UI, SQLite for data persistence, and scikit-learn for predictive modeling.

## File Map

### Core Application
- main.py: Streamlit application entry point with landing page and navigation setup
- requirements.txt: Python dependencies including Streamlit, SQLAlchemy, scikit-learn, Plotly, and Google Generative AI
- Dockerfile: Container deployment configuration for production environment
- .env.template: Environment variable template for API key configuration

### Source Modules (src/)
- src/database.py: SQLAlchemy ORM models and database operations for LOT data, sensory profiles, analysis indices, and measurements
- src/analysis.py: ML predictor (SensoryPredictor) for regression-based sensory score prediction and flavor analysis utilities
- src/llm.py: Google Gemini integration (GeminiFlavorReporter) for AI-generated flavor reports and chemical insights
- src/chem_utils.py: PubChemPy and RDKit utilities for compound lookup and chemical property calculation
- src/maintenance.py: Database maintenance and migration utilities

### Streamlit Pages (pages/)
- pages/1_Data_Entry.py: LOT data registration with chemical composition input
- pages/2_Flavor_Analysis.py: Detailed flavor analysis for prototypes and LOT samples with GCMS data upload
- pages/3_Analysis_Result.py: Unified analysis result viewer with edit/delete capabilities
- pages/4_Prediction.py: ML-based sensory score prediction interface
- pages/5_Sensory.py: Sensory evaluation and multi-LOT comparison with radar charts
- pages/6_Report.py: AI-powered comprehensive flavor report generation
- pages/7_Settings.py: System configuration for analysis indices and GCMS compound library

### Data Storage (data/)
- data/liquor_analytics.db: SQLite database storing all LOT data, measurements, and sensory profiles
- data/models/: Directory for trained ML model serialization (pickle files)
- data/master_flavor_db.csv: Master flavor compound database with odor thresholds and descriptors

### Knowledge Base (knowledge_base/)
- knowledge_base/flavor_chemistry.md: Reference documentation for flavor chemistry principles
- knowledge_base/system_persona.md: AI system persona and analysis guidelines
- knowledge_base/report_template.md: Template structure for AI-generated reports

### Documentation
- README.md: Korean language user guide with installation, usage, and deployment instructions
- QUICKSTART.md: Quick start guide for new users
- IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md: Daily development log and feature implementation summary
- .github/copilot-instructions.md: AI coding assistant guidelines (Karpathy principles)

### Build & Utilities
- .devcontainer/: Development container configuration
- .gitignore: Git exclusion patterns for build artifacts and environment files
- migrate_db.py: Database schema migration script
- test_api.py: API integration testing utilities
- debug_env.py: Environment debugging script
- extract_tags.py: GCMS data tag extraction utilities

## Tech Stack

### Languages
- Python 3.11+

### Web Framework
- Streamlit 1.31.0+ (Interactive web UI)

### Database
- SQLite (Local persistence)
- SQLAlchemy 2.0.0+ (ORM layer)
- pysqlite3-binary 0.5.2+ (Linux compatibility)

### Machine Learning
- scikit-learn 1.3.0+ (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, Linear/Ridge/Lasso regression)
- pandas 2.0.0+ (Data manipulation)
- numpy 1.24.0+ (Numerical computing)

### Data Visualization
- Plotly 5.18.0+ (Interactive charts and radar plots)

### AI/LLM
- google-generativeai 0.3.0+ (Gemini API for flavor reports and chemical insights)

### Chemical Informatics
- pubchempy 1.0.4+ (Compound database lookup)
- rdkit 2023.9.1+ (Molecular property calculation and structure rendering)

### Data Processing
- pyarrow 14.0.0+ (Parquet support for data export)
- python-dotenv 1.0.0+ (Environment variable management)

### Deployment
- Docker (Container deployment)
- Streamlit Community Cloud (Cloud hosting option)
